items.title: Bob Magnusson interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: The transcript identifies Monk Rowe as the interviewer ('[INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Rowe... I have a feeling when you work with Roger it’s always an adventure.') and Bob Magnusson as the interviewee. There is no dialogue or narrative from the interviewee describing a personal, professional, or so

ctx.x: Bob was interviewed in Los Angeles on February 14, 1999, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe and we are in Los Angeles filming for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive. I’m very pleased to have Bob Magnusson with me, after a burning set at the International Jazz Party. I have a feeling when you work with Roger it’s always an adventure.
